compressionParam.description:
This field specifies the ratio at which we want to compress our bins. Typically the final number of bins is around
compressionParam / 2. The field will be ignored if the data is not numeric.

binEdges.description:
The field specifies the range of each bin (Left inclusive & right exclusive).
E.g. [1,11,21,31,41,51,61] will create 6 bins from 1-11,11-21,21-31,31-41,41-51,51-61

minValue.description:
The minValue can be used to restrict the range of the histogram.

If either of them is null,  min of the actual data range is assumed

maxValue.description:
The maxValue can be used to restrict the range of the histogram.

If either of them is null,  max of the actual data range is assumed

title: A specification for what/how data is stored in a Histogram
name: HistogramSpec
